text:
alex: Quick check — customer demo on Tue 08:00 JST wants 4x H100 for ~30m. Do we have any standby capacity in APAC or a fast fallback plan?

maria: Not in the reserved demo pool AFAIK. We do have some spot H100s in ap-northeast1 but eviction risk is high at that hour. Can they tolerate degraded perf? :thinking_face:

alex: They need full perf for the first 10m (interactive). After that we can drop to a smaller model. Thinking a hybrid: 2x reserved H100 + 2x spot A100 as fallback.

jin: Vendor said ETA for extra H100 racks is late this month. For a short window we could try a burst borrow from partner rack — need ops approval. Pinged vendor (partner-gpu@vendor.example) this morning.

sam: If we go hybrid we should lock a quota change + terraform PR for the demo so oncall doesn't scramble. I can open a tiny PR to increase demo-pool count for Tue and then revert.

sam: Example tf snippet I can put in the PR:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "demo_burst" {
  region = "ap-northeast1"
  gpu_type = "h100"
  count = 2
  labels = { purpose = "demo-burst-temp" }
  expire_after = "2026-03-10T10:30:00Z"
}
```

maria: That expire_after is good. Also add a fallback route in the canary policy so requests automatically route to a100-spot if h100 latency > 150ms.

ops-bot: Created vendor ticket GPU-8673 and partner request PR-4527. Vendor ETA: tentative 2026-03-09 18:00 UTC.

jin: Ops approval: @maria can shepherd the partner borrow? If yes I can swap some burst credits from EU to APAC (low impact).

maria: I can handle partner side, will confirm SLA and run a short smoke test at 07:15 JST Tue. @alex please send the exact test script so we can validate perf.

alex: Will drop test script in the thread — simple: 1) 10 prompts with max_tokens=2048, 2) measure p50/p95 latency, 3) verify token output checksum. Link to template: https://redwood.internal/docs/demo-runbook#perf-checks

sam: I'll open PR-9981 (quota bump) and mark it as emergency with ttl. If vendor falls through we flip the routing policy to prefer a100-spot automatically.

alex: Great. TL;DR action items: sam -> open TF + quota PR, maria -> partner borrow + smoke test, jin -> shift burst credits if needed, ops-bot -> keep vendor ticket updated. Will reconvene async EOD for confirmation. :thumbsup:
